reason: Reproduced with uv 0.12.24 on Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 and system CPython 3.12.3. Create <tmp>/python/3.12/python3 as a symlink to /usr/bin/python3.12, then run `uv --cache-dir <warm> venv --python <symlink> <venv>`. Query using `uv --cache-dir <warm> pip list --python <venv>/bin/python` and repeat with an empty cache. Decoded sys_base_executable values differ exactly as reported: the warmed cache contains the fixture symlink; the fresh cache contains /usr/bin/python3.12. Subsequent venv creation also selects different base paths. uv 0.12.23 and 0.12.13 cache the queried canonical path; selecting /usr/bin/python3.12 directly avoids this mismatch in 0.12.24. The existing crates/uv/tests/python/venv.rs::create_venv_caches_interpreter asserts cached/fresh metadata equality; it was inspected, not run. The regression follows cache warming introduced by astral-sh/uv#21304. Gentoo itself was not tested. The requested README update failed because its filesystem is read-only; the complete handoff is saved at /tmp/uv-22383.JgzJk8/README.md.
